title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
**ORACLE EVENING BRIEF — April 12, 2026**

Bitcoin's sliding into extreme fear territory down nearly two percent at $71,580, but institutional momentum tells a different story. Ten-plus billion in ETF inflows this quarter signal serious capital moving in. Geopolitical pressure—Iran pivoting to Bitcoin, U.S. officials scrambling for crypto legislation—is forcing Bitcoin into state-level strategies faster than consensus predicted.

The hashrate holding steady at 834.6 EH/s confirms network resilie
